reply.text:
That's a real cost, and it's worth fixing rather than just putting up with. If you want to cut it, a home setup can carry you a long way: a pair of adjustable dumbbells, a bench and a pull-up bar will cover most of what a good program needs. Outdoor running and bodyweight work cost nothing at all.

If you'd like, tell me what you have at home and how many days a week you want to train, and I'll build you something that fits. Or I can build a bodyweight-only block so you're not spending a cent.
